When a pendulum passes a marker, a timer displays 1 minute 30 seconds.
The pendulum passes the marker 12 more times from the same direction.
On the final pass, the timer displays a time of 2 minutes 18 seconds.
What is the time period of oscillation of the pendulum?
A
4.0s
B
4.4s
C
7.5s
D
12s
subject: Physics
